gloss_en: medaber — 'the speaker': the human/articulate level in the fourfold hierarchy of creation (mineral, vegetable, animal, speaker), i.e., humankind defined by the faculty of speech

outliers.actual_gloss_en: wilderness/desert — as in 'u-mi-midbar matanah' (Numbers 21:18), symbolizing lowliness/self-effacement (making oneself ownerless like a wilderness)
outliers.reason: Homograph: here the word is the noun midbar (wilderness) from the verse ממדבר מתנה, paired with shiflut (lowliness), not medaber (the speaking being) of the chai/medaber hierarchy.
